text:
Alex: Night window tonight 00:30 UTC — need someone to press prod for the DB schema patch. Who can press? Need MFA + deploy role. @Jamal? :wave:

Maria: I can't stay up that late, apologies. Can we shift to 23:30 or do a handoff?

Jamal: I can cover 00:30 if we can get a short JIT extension. My JIT token expires at 00:00.

Alex: Can we pin the release beforehand so rollback is straightforward? Also we need the deploy role check clarified — is deployer.press the only permission needed?

deploy-bot: auto-check: user Jamal missing permission "roles/deployer.press". To request temporary grant run:
```
/jit-request --user Jamal --env prod --duration 2h --reason "night window DB patch"
```

SRE Oncall: We can approve a scoped JIT. Two quick things: (1) confirm Jamal's MFA enrollment (2) we'll add an audit note in the ticket. I can approve once request exists.

Jamal: MFA is enrolled (phone + U2F). Opening the JIT now.

Alex: Good. Also pin the service to v3.2.1-release-candidate before pressing (so rollback = pin to v3.2.0). Add release notes link in the ticket.

Maria: +1 on pinning. If deploy-bot healthcheck fails after press, plan is immediate rollback to v3.2.0 and page SRE.

Jamal: /jit-request submitted — request id JIT-8392. Reason: "Night window DB patch, need deploy role to press".

SRE Oncall: Approved JIT-8392 for 2h. Audit: "approved night window deploy for Jamal; approver SRE Oncall". Leaving comment in ticket.

Alex: Thanks. Jamal — when you press, run:
```
deploy-bot release --pin v3.2.1 --env prod --canary 5%
```
Post the deploy-bot output + canary metrics here after the push.

Jamal: Will do. I'll also snapshot DB and attach link to the runbook in the ticket. :thumbsup:

Alex: Copy. Closing planning — will monitor channel during window.

Maria: Thanks all, appreciate the handoff.
